correctness.rationale: A directed overlap graph on all linear 11-free length-n words has F_(n+2) required edges. Rightmost-one shift potential has drop at most one on any additional arc. The sum of drops on required edges is −(F_n−1), enforcing at least F_n−1 duplicate arcs. Duplicating exactly 0u0 for all nonzero 11-free middle words u balances every vertex; strongly connected augmented graph has an Euler circuit. Thus M_n=F_(n+2)+F_n−1 for every n>=2. Independent augmentation, balance and potential calculations matched n=2..12. The all-n proof is analytic.
